candidates.description: This vector represents higher education, academia, and advanced degrees.
This vector represents academic disciplines, scientific fields, and technological domains.
This feature vector represents honorific titles and academic prefixes used to address professionals or authorities.
This vector activates on words, prefixes, and subwords starting with the letters "con" or "assoc".
This feature vector represents concepts related to formal education, schooling, and academic environments.
This feature activates on words and word fragments related to institutional, academic, and universal concepts, frequently handling suffixes and roots containing "-vers-" or "-university".
This feature vector represents common Italian auxiliary, modal, and copular verbs in various inflected forms.
These tokens represent common Italian verb infinitive suffixes.
This vector represents adjectives describing various domains, contexts, or characteristics of human activity and nature.
This feature activates on common prefixes, capitalized stems, and proper noun roots, particularly relating to academic subjects, philosophical terms, and brand names.
